inputs.text: [excited] Its open wings spanned 10 meters wingtip to wingtip — as wide as six Dads lying head to toe. [quickly] Laid end to end, as long as a truck. Standing up, 3 meters tall — [proud] as tall as a basketball hoop. And 220 kilos — as heavy as a lion.
[gasps] As tall as a basketball hoop?

[confident] Yes. [slowly] But its real difference is its neck: unlike Quetzalcoatlus, its long, thin-necked cousin, [amazed] this one had a short, thick neck, almost like a bull, with a huge head on top.
